prompt: A moving company charges according to $C(t) = 32t + 150$, where $C$ is the total cost in dollars and $t$ is the number of hours worked. What does the number $32$ represent?

choices.label: The fixed cost before any work begins
The cost per hour of work
The total cost of a one-hour job
The number of hours included in the base charge

hint: The number attached to $t$ is a *rate*. Ask what units it must carry.

hints.text: The number attached to $t$ is a *rate*. Ask what units it must carry.
$C$ is in dollars and $t$ is in hours, so the coefficient of $t$ is in dollars per hour.
$32$ is the cost per hour; $150$ is the fixed charge.

learningObjective: Interpret the slope of a linear model in context, with units.
explanation: In a linear model, the coefficient of the variable is the slope, and the slope is always a rate: output units per input unit.
Here the output is dollars and the input is hours, so $32$ is measured in dollars per hour — the cost of each additional hour.
The constant $150$ is what you pay when $t = 0$: the fixed charge. Choice C is the trap — a one-hour job costs $32 + 150 = \$182$, not $\$32$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Compare two inputs
steps: One extra hour of work added exactly $\$32$ to the bill.
That is the definition of the slope in this context — what one more hour costs.
